description: Impacts of electric vehicles (EV) on the increase in electricity demand/consumption is a data set deposited in wuua.wqayci by its authors Mohamed Badhrudeen. Deploying electric vehicles (EVs) is one of the pathways to achieve net zero emissions. However, the indirect effect of deploying electric vehicles is the added demand/consumption of electricity needed to charge. The contribution is to compare the electricity demand/consumption for different EV penetration rate at different regions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
